component.name: BitBraid
component.summary: See and shape the history of a git repository

description.p: BitBraid is a native git client written in Rust. It draws a repository's history as a graph of lanes on the GPU, and works on it from there.

ul.li: Staging down to single lines, commits and amends, and undo of what changes the repository
Branches, tags and stashes; fetch, pull and push; merge, rebase and interactive rebase, with conflicts resolved file by file
Worktrees, submodules, Git LFS, and signing with gpg, ssh and X.509
A terminal for each repository, inside the window
GitHub and GitLab: cloning, pull requests, issues and checks

description.p: It runs the git installed on the system, and sends nothing anywhere unasked.
